dataset.name: Method used in Tokunaga, T. et al. 2018 for simulating time- and depth- dependent temperature variations in soil and sediment in Rifle, Colorado, 2013-2016.
description: This data package contains temperature, moisture content, matric potential, and carbon dioxide (CO2) concentration data from the Rifle, Colorado field site and from a 2 meter tall laboratory soil/sediment column designed to simulate field conditions. In addition, redox potential data from the laboratory column are included. The purpose of the data and paper is to demonstrate how a laboratory column was constructed to reproduce the dynamics of nonisothermal conditions in the field, such that CO2 production above a variable-depth water table can be studied in the laboratory. The data package contains 3 data files corresponding to the figures in the related paper (Tokunaga, T. et al. 2018) and 1 README file with the paper information.

spatialCoverage.description: Rifle, Colorado US-RIF. The Rifle site is located in the east side of the Upper Colorado River Basin (UCRB) in northwestern Colorado. The site had a former uranium and vanadium mill, which operated between 1924 and 1958. As a uranium‐contaminated site it has been the focus of several intense hydrological, biogeochemical, and bioremediation research activities., and was used by the DOE Sustainable Systems Scientific Focus Area to explore how climate drivers influence hydrological processes and biogeochemical cycling within the Colorado River Basin. The Rifle site is located atop a floodplain adjacent to the Colorado River floodplain systems within the UCRB, and is representative of floodplains in the UCRB based upon its overall aquifer properties and hydrological coupling to the Colorado River.

measurementTechnique:
A 2 meter tall column was packed with soil/sediment from the Rifle floodplain, and constructed to control the temperature profile and water table depth to reproduce conditions observed at the field site.
All methods have been described in the publication Tokunaga, T.K., Y. Kim, J. Wan, M. Bill, M. Conrad, W. Dong. (2018), Method for controlling temperature profiles and water table depths in laboratory sediment columns, Vadose Zone Journal. 17:180085 doi: 10.2136/vzj2018.04.0085
